questions: When a deletion occurs in the middle of the string, does the operation allow multiple disjoint deletions to happen simultaneously in one step, or only one contiguous substring per operation?
Are the bracket pairs strictly matching in type (i.e., '(' with ')', '[' with ']', '<' with '>'), or can any opening bracket be paired with any closing bracket for a valid deletion?
Does the substring to delete have to be exactly two characters (one opening and one closing), or can it be longer if it forms a valid nested structure?
Is the order of characters within the substring required to be opening then closing (e.g., '()'), or is reverse order (e.g., ')(') also acceptable for deletion?
When multiple valid contiguous substrings exist, can we choose any, or is there a priority (e.g., leftmost, innermost)?
Does the string need to be reduced to empty exactly, or is it acceptable if no operations are possible but the string is non-empty?
Are there any constraints on the sequence of deletions, such as requiring deletions to be non-overlapping or in a specific order?
Is the string considered colorful bracket sequence only if all possible sequences of deletions lead to an empty string, or if at least one sequence does?
